question: In ΔABC, D and E are the points on sides AB and BC, respectively, such that DE ∥ AC. If BD = 3 cm and AD = 4 cm, then frac{{{{Area}} Delta {{BDE}}}}{{{{Area}} {{of}} {{quadrilateral}} {{ADEC}}}} = frac{{{p}}}{{{q}}}, where p, q are coprime. What is the value of |p - q|?
solution:
**Given:**

BD = 3 cm

AD = 4 cm

**Concept:**

The area of similar triangles is proportional to the square of their corresponding sides. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aaad8aea989c197f2591a1ee5a01ddf517bcc87a6ac51b16c477e41d444d95b7.png] 

In the figure, ΔADE ~ ΔABC.

⇒ AD²over AB² = ar ΔADEover ar Δ ABC

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3f02c58b7c1d692f34e4f199441f3f7f1d3e17559d16ff803483d339a4ecd2c7.png] 

In the figure, ΔBDE ~ ΔABC (through AAA criterion)

⇒ BD²over AB² = ar ΔBDEover ar Δ ABC

⇒ ar ΔBDEover ar Δ ABC = 3²over (3+4)² = 9over 49

From the figure, area of quadrilateral ADEC = ar ABC - ar BDE

Area of quadrilateral ADEC = 49 - 9 = 40

According to the question

⇒frac{{{{Area}} Δ {{BDE}}}}{{{{Area}} {{of}} {{quadrilateral}} {{ADEC}}}} = frac{{{p}}}{{{q}}} = 9over 40

Using the value of "p" and "q" in the expression |p - q| 

⇒ |9 - 40| = 31

∴ **The answer is 31.**
